- Thu 00:00 UTC (Thu 08:00 SGT / Wed 17:00 PT)

Plan: run a 60-minute technical deep dive + 15 minutes for next-steps; rotate the meeting weekly on the schedule above so each region takes a friendly week once per three weeks. If rotating is too complicated we can set two alternating slots per month.

Action items:
1) Can you confirm which of the three options looks best for your team or share your preferred windows?
2) Does Liam have a preferred timezone to anchor invites in (e.g., Europe/London)?
